title: FrontmatterOpenCodeAgent
description: Frontmatter shape for nodes classified as `agent` by the OpenCode Provider. OpenCode agents live as markdown files under `.opencode/agent/<name>.md` (https://opencode.ai/docs/agents); the markdown body is the agent prompt. There is NO `name` field, the filename stem is the handle. Field set mirrors OpenCode's documented agent frontmatter; `additionalProperties: true` lets any other inherited key flow through unchanged.

description.description: What the agent does and when to use it. OpenCode surfaces this when selecting a subagent; skill-map mirrors it in the card. Required: a description-less agent cannot be meaningfully selected.

mode.description: How the agent runs: `primary` (a top-level agent the user can switch to), `subagent` (invoked by another agent via the `task` tool), or `all`. Inherits OpenCode's default when omitted.

model.description: Model the agent runs against, in OpenCode's `provider/model` form (e.g. `anthropic/claude-opus-4-8`). Inherits the parent's model when omitted.

permission.description: Per-tool permission policy. Each documented tool key maps to `allow`, `ask`, or `deny`; `bash` may instead be a map of command globs to policies. Any tool omitted inherits OpenCode's default.

bash.description: Either a blanket policy or a per-command-glob map.
